name: empty
useFor: Use where a list, map panel or report has nothing to show yet (No sites yet, No parcels match, No site selected). Use EmptyMark for the first-run state of a main view and EmptyMedia variant="icon" with a Phosphor glyph for a filtered or selection state. Say what is missing and what to do next; offer at most one action.
source: Brand principles (thin rules with nodes at their crossings) and the Diamond node, for a designer's review
title: Empty
description: A centered empty state: the survey node (an outlined diamond where two 1px rules cross) or a square glyph tile, a 16px regular title, a muted line and one action.
